description_html:
Key Features

  • High Load Capacity: Rated to safely transport up to 913 kilograms, making it ideal for moving heavy diving equipment or supplies.
  • Extended Deck Length: Features a spacious 447-centimeter deck, providing ample space for large or multiple items.
  • Lightweight Construction: Weighs only 21 kilograms (tare mass), ensuring easy maneuverability and reduced handling effort.
  • Self-Propelled Traction: Equipped with a self-propelled drive system for smooth, effortless movement without manual pushing or towing.
  • Optimized for Controlled Environments: Designed to operate efficiently at a stable temperature of 25°C, suitable for indoor or climate-controlled settings.
  • Halocline-Trimmed Design: Incorporates halocline-trimmed components for enhanced performance in marine or diving-related applications.

Main Benefits

  • Efficient Transport: Streamlines the movement of heavy or bulky items, reducing manual labor and increasing workplace productivity.
  • Enhanced Safety: High load rating and stable deck design minimize the risk of tipping or overloading, addressing common safety concerns.
  • User-Friendly Operation: Self-propelled mechanism and lightweight build make it easy to operate, even in confined spaces or by a single user.
  • Versatile Application: Suitable for use in diving centers, marine supply depots, warehouses, or any environment requiring reliable load handling.
  • Durability and Reliability: Engineered for consistent use in controlled temperatures, ensuring long service life and dependable performance.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Diving Equipment Transport: Ideal for safely moving compressed air tanks, wetsuits, or other heavy dive gear between storage and dive sites.
  • Warehouse Material Handling: Fits the needs of logistics teams seeking a compact, self-propelled dolly for efficient inventory movement.
  • Marine Facility Operations: Supports the daily workflow in marinas or aquatic centers, where corrosion resistance and load stability are essential.
  • General Heavy Load Mobility: Meets the requirements of users searching for a robust, easy-to-use dolly for transporting heavy goods in various settings.
